india.one_line: India pushes AI regulation while firms report revenue growth and seek debt financing for data centre expansion.

themes.title: AI regulatory framework expands
themes.text: The government will issue a consultation paper on AI legislation in the coming weeks, and SEBI plans to launch an AI sandbox and graded broker compliance framework.

stories.headline: India to issue AI law consultation paper in coming weeks, says minister
SEBI to introduce graded broker compliance, AI sandbox, and corporate bond reforms

themes.title: Infosys AI revenue climbs
themes.text: Infosys reported AI revenue grew 29% quarter‑on‑quarter, now representing 10.5% of total revenue, while cutting its FY27 growth outlook to 1‑2%.

stories.headline: Infosys AI revenue rises 29% QoQ as FY27 growth guidance cut to 1-2%

themes.title: AI sector seeks debt financing
themes.text: A Union Bank of India report says India's AI firms will increasingly rely on debt financing to build data centres, citing GPU obsolescence and regulatory risks.

stories.headline: India's AI sector looks to debt financing for data centres amid GPU and regulatory risks
